component.name: Konqi Pet
component.summary: A chaotic desktop pet using KDE's dragon mascot

description.p: Konqi is KDE's official mascot, and now he lives on your desktop. He walks around your screen, climbs the edges, falls off things, and falls asleep when you are boring.

Every few seconds something random happens - he teleports, trips over nothing, summons a second copy of himself to argue with, or writes a bad poem about whatever you have open. He watches which apps you use and has escalating opinions the longer you stay in them.

ul.li: Full physics - gravity, wall climbing, bouncing
Reacts to 200+ window titles with unique dialogue
Chaos events: teleport, spin, drift, dive, glitch, summon twin
Plays tic-tac-toe and gets smug about it
Reacts to CPU, notifications, typing speed, and wallpaper colour
